title: Unlocking Pretrained Vision Transformers for Time Series Classification
abstract: arXiv:2506.08641v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Adapting vision models for time series analysis is compelling, yet all existing approaches are falling short of dedicated time series foundation models (TSFMs) in classification. In this work, we propose Time Vision Transformer (TiViT), the first framework that successfully unlocks the representational power of frozen Vision Transformers (ViTs) pretrained on large-scale image datasets for time series classification. TiViT achieves state-of-the-art performance without any finetuning by utilizing the hidden representations of OpenCLIP models. We explore the structure of TiViT representations and find that intermediate ViT layers with high intrinsic dimension are the most effective for time series classification. Furthermore, we assess the alignment between TiViT and TSFM representation spaces and identify a strong complementarity, with additional performance gains achieved through feature concatenation. translated_title: 解锁预训练视觉变换器用于时间序列分类
translated_abstract: 将视觉模型应用于时间序列分析颇具吸引力，然而所有现有方法在分类任务上的表现仍不及专门的时间序列基础模型（TSFM）。在这项工作中，我们提出了时间视觉变换器，这是首个成功解锁在大规模图像数据集上预训练的冻结视觉变换器（ViT）表征能力并将其用于时间序列分类的框架。TiViT 通过利用 OpenCLIP 模型的隐藏表征，无需任何微调即可实现最先进的性能。我们探索了 TiViT 表征的结构，发现具有高内在维度的中间 ViT 层对时间序列分类最为有效。此外，我们评估了 TiViT 与 TSFM 表征空间之间的对齐程度，发现二者具有很强的互补性，通过特征拼接可获得额外的性能提升。最后，我们解冻了 ViT 骨干网络……
tldr: 提出TiViT框架，首次成功利用在图像数据集上预训练的冻结视觉变换器的隐藏表征进行时间序列分类，无需微调即达到最先进性能，且其表征与时间序列基础模型高度互补，特征拼接可进一步提升效果。
